text: If anyone is considering braces or any dental work, I highly recommend this clinic. Dr. Jeab is incredibly skilled. From my personal experience, I learned about her clinic from a senior colleague at a hotel in Phuket. I had crooked teeth and gaps between my teeth. I consulted several clinics, but none would treat me because I had too much cartilage in the upper part of my mouth where it connects to the gums. They all suggested I have the bone removed first before I could get braces, which was extremely expensive at the time. I was quite discouraged. But after meeting Dr. Jeab, I gained renewed hope. She gave me very straightforward advice. I had gum surgery, fillings, extractions, and even my wisdom teeth removed (which were growing at an unusual angle). I also decided to have all the cartilage removed by her because I believed that all teeth, especially the wisdom teeth, are connected to the nervous system. I felt very confident in Dr. Jeab. My case was one of the most challenging, requiring extensive corrections, but I overcame it. Dr. Jeab provided excellent care and guidance, helping me achieve my current confident smile. Thank you so much, Dr. Jeab! Since then, I recommend this clinic to all my friends and colleagues who need braces. She's incredibly skilled and trustworthy. ❤️❤️
